quote: We have specified Defenseply WPC Door Frames and Calibrated Boards across multiple commercial and residential developments across Kerala. The batch-to-batch density uniformity is outstanding, screw holding is rock solid, and site carpenters praise how cleanly the material routes without splintering.

For waterfront villas and backwater resorts around Ernakulam, moisture in modular joinery used to be our biggest headache. We shifted all kitchen carcass and bathroom vanities to Defenseply 18mm PVC foam boards two years ago. Even through the heaviest South-West monsoons, zero swelling, zero fungus, and hinges hold tight without loosening.
name: Ar. Tony Mathew
